answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted vouching: a new identity can only be admitted on the onyx ledge of the ledger once an established agent posts a bond that is slashed in proportion to the fake accounts it later sponsors. Because every sock puppet drags its voucher's capital down, one attacker must fund every clone at real cost. Like water sinking through a karst, identities leak in slowly and each forged one permanently drains the sponsor's balance.
